_about: Voice recipes for render.py. A clip's recipe = defaults <- speaker <- defaults.delivery[kind] <- speaker.delivery[kind]; kind is speech, command, shout or cry (render.py maps a line's delivery word onto one, unless the line sets "kind"). The speaker sets the voice, the delivery the vocal effort. timbre/prosody: Kokoro voice blend weights (style dims 0-127 condition the decoder = timbre, 128-255 the prosody predictor = rhythm and melody). formant: vocal-tract scale by resampling (<1 = bigger, darker). f0_st: pitch shift in semitones made inside the model (formants untouched); f0_delivery_st adds the delivery's raise. speed x speed_mul: tempo. accent_st: height of the Ancient Greek pitch accent over the accented vowel; accent_energy: its loudness (Kokoro energy units, +2 = about +2 dB). accent_len / final_len: duration scale of the accented / phrase-final vowel. eq: the voice's tone; effort_eq: the delivery's spectral tilt. Bands: {type: highpass|lowpass|peak|lowshelf|highshelf, f Hz, gain dB, q}. saturation (delivery) and grit (speaker, added): tanh drive and wet mix. compressor: threshold dBFS (signal pre-set to -20 LUFS), ratio, attack/release ms, knee dB. max_ms caps phoneme durations. phone_map: optional per-speaker phoneme substitutions (an accent). See RESEARCH.md for the measurements behind each number.

Leonidas._why: The king: deep, dark and clean. am_onyx timbre (lowest pitch of the 23 male voices, F0 ~83 Hz) with 30% am_michael for presence; Italian im_nicola prosody for pure Mediterranean vowels (best intelligibility of the blends tried); slow, with a strong pitch accent. Speech F0 ~100 Hz, commands ~145, shouts and cries ~150-165.

Dienekes._why: A second veteran, brighter and rougher than the king: am_michael timbre lowered 3 semitones with a 5% bigger vocal tract, Spanish em_alex prosody (livelier, wry), brighter presence at 1.8 kHz. Speech F0 ~105-120 Hz (as low as the king, told apart by timbre: MFCC distance 61 against 14 within one voice). Extra grit (saturation) was tried and dropped: it cost intelligibility (control CER 0.28 vs 0.06).

Lookout._why: A young man: am_adam timbre with Portuguese pm_alex prosody, 2% smaller vocal tract, quick. Speech F0 ~140 Hz, alarm calls ~170.

Herald._why: Xerxes' herald, formal and foreign: Hindi hm_psi (an Indo-Iranian rhythm and melody on the Greek), 1.5 semitones lower, slow and measured, slightly nasal.

Trachinian._why: An ordinary local man of Trachis: a Spanish em_alex / American am_echo timbre blend (60/40) with em_alex prosody, mid pitch (speech F0 ~127 Hz, alarm ~175), a thinner, slightly nasal everyman tone (less chest, +2.5 dB at 1.4 kHz). Plain am_echo was the voice nearest to the king's (MFCC distance 29-33); the blend moves him to 36-51 from every other speaker.
